provenance.note: Arithmetic components are derived from the price panel. Judgment components were supplied 2026-08-26 with sourced reasoning. MID-CYCLE MANUAL RUN: judgment written 2026-08-26, five calendar days after the 2026-08-21 close this file reads. Two of the five sessions in the week window (Mon 08-24, Tue 08-25) had already traded. The three catalysts that dominate the window -- July core PCE and NVDA earnings (both 08-26), and the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote (08-28) -- were all still ahead, and the pinned research snapshot (2026-08-24) carries no post-08-21 outcomes. The week horizon is still not a clean ex-ante forecast and must not be graded as one.

day.unavailable: The day horizon needs daily bars; the upstream feed commits Friday closes only.

why: Archetype 1 gives Consumer Discretionary +32.6 pct absolute but only +1.3 pts excess -- its standout regime is archetype 2 (easy-money early cycle, +17.1 pts), which this is not (The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).

The consumer evidence in this window is uniformly negative: retail sales -0.6 pct, UMich 51.0, housing starts -12.4 pct with single-family down three of four months at 6.65 pct mortgages, and a WMT comp miss that dominated the 08-20 tape (wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba).
risks: Personal income and spending print 08-26; spending below 0.0 pct on top of the fresh retail miss would confirm the consumer crack at the income-statement level (wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba).

why: The month arithmetic disagrees with the macro read -- the panel has the sector +9.13 pts vs SPY with 90.0 breadth, among the strongest in the run. The disagreement is preserved rather than resolved: the regime_fit reflects the regime and consumer data, the components reflect the tape (panel metrics, this file; wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba).

Discretionary is the classic canary when the wallet closes, so a high month reading against deteriorating consumer prints is exactly the contradiction worth logging rather than smoothing (wiki/consumer-discretionary.md@fb83ca39).
risks: Consumer Confidence on 08-25 plus UMich at 51.0 would harden the consumer flag on a second straight drop; a rebound would say the WMT shock was company-specific (wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba).

extracts.lead_summary: The consumer is the canary in the coal mine. When the wallet closes, discretionary dies first.
